title: Prime Ministers Salary Allowance and Privileges Amendment Act 1997

sections.shortTitle: Prime Ministers Salary Allowance and Privileges Amendment Act 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXX OF 1997
ACT XXX OF 1997
PRIME MINISTER'S
SALARY ALLOWANCE AND
PRIVILEGES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
An Act further to
amend the Prime Minister's
Salary, Allowances
and Privileges Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
20th September,
1997]
No.F.22(96)/97-Legis., dated
20-9-1997.--The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the
assent of the President on the 16th September, 1997, is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.--This Act may be called the Prim Minister's Salary,
Allowances and Privileges (Amendment) Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
